queries.text:
WITH RECURSIVE countdown AS (
  SELECT CAST(?1 AS INTEGER) AS n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n - 1 FROM countdown WHERE n > 1
)
SELECT n FROM countdown
queries.name: Countdown

queries.text:
WITH view_counts AS (
  SELECT title_id, count(*) AS view_count FROM views GROUP BY title_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT title_id, view_count, CAST(rank() OVER (ORDER BY view_count DESC) AS INTEGER) AS place FROM view_counts
)
SELECT t.id, t.name, ranked.view_count, ranked.place
FROM titles t JOIN ranked ON ranked.title_id = t.id
WHERE ranked.view_count >= CAST(?1 AS INTEGER) AND t.status = ?2
ORDER BY ranked.place, t.id
queries.name: PopularTitles
comments: Two CTEs, the second reading the first.

queries.text:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM titles WHERE id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?)
)
SELECT id, name FROM picked WHERE name <> ?1 ORDER BY id
queries.name: PickTitles
comments: A slice inside the CTE still expands after the scalar that follows it.

queries.text:
SELECT titles.id, titles.name, titles.status, titles.price, titles.rating, titles.meta, titles.poster, titles.is_public, titles.published_on, titles.created_at, views.title_id, views.viewed_at
FROM titles JOIN views ON views.title_id = titles.id
WHERE titles.id = ?1
ORDER BY views.viewed_at DESC LIMIT 1
queries.name: GetTitleWithView
comments: A title with its latest view; sqlc.embed() nests each table's columns.

queries.text:
SELECT titles.id, titles.name, v.title_id, v.viewed_at
FROM titles LEFT JOIN views AS v ON v.title_id = titles.id
ORDER BY titles.id, v.viewed_at
queries.name: ListTitlesWithViews
comments: The embed is marked @nullable because the LEFT JOIN can leave every views column NULL.
@nullable views

queries.text: SELECT label, count, code, ratio, big FROM misc WHERE label = ? LIMIT 1
queries.name: GetMisc

queries.text: INSERT INTO misc (label, count, code, ratio, big) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
queries.name: CreateMisc

queries.text: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM misc
queries.name: CountMisc

queries.text: SELECT id, name, status, price, rating, meta, poster, is_public, published_on, created_at FROM titles WHERE id = ?
queries.name: GetTitle
comments: One title by id.

queries.text:
SELECT id, name, price FROM titles
WHERE status = ?1 AND (price >= ?2 OR ?2 IS NULL)
ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListTitlesByStatus
comments: sqlc types a parameter from its first use, so the comparison has to come before IS NULL.

queries.text: SELECT id, name FROM titles WHERE id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) AND status = ?
queries.name: ListTitlesByIds
comments: Anonymous ? after the slice: sqlc numbers it 1, the slice comes last.

queries.text: SELECT id FROM titles WHERE status = ?1 AND (id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) OR name IN (/*SLICE:names*/?))
queries.name: ListTitlesByIdsOrNames

queries.text: SELECT id FROM titles WHERE id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) OR id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListTitlesByIdsTwice
comments: The same slice twice: sqlc emits one parameter and two markers.

queries.text:
INSERT INTO titles (name, status, price, meta, poster, is_public, published_on)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
RETURNING id, created_at
queries.name: CreateTitle

queries.text: UPDATE titles SET name = ? WHERE id = ?
queries.name: RenameTitle

queries.text: DELETE FROM titles WHERE id = ?
queries.name: DeleteTitle

queries.text: SELECT '`tick` ${x} ? \n' AS literal, "price" FROM titles LIMIT 1
queries.name: QuotedLiteral
comments: Backticks and ${} in SQL must survive the template literal: `a` ${b}
A '?' inside a string literal is not a parameter.

queries.text: SELECT id, name FROM titles ORDER BY id LIMIT ?2 OFFSET ?1
queries.name: ListTitlesPaged
comments: :name and $name placeholders, which sqlc rewrites to ?N like @name.

queries.text: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM titles
queries.name: CountTitles
comments: SQLite names an unaliased expression column by its text (`count(*)`), not the `count`
sqlc guesses, so expression columns need an alias here. Postgres names them as sqlc does.

queries.text: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM titles WHERE id = ?) AS title_exists
queries.name: TitleExists

queries.text:
UPDATE titles
SET name = COALESCE(?1, name),
    status = COALESCE(?2, status),
    price = COALESCE(?3, price)
WHERE id = ?4
RETURNING id, name, status, price, rating, meta, poster, is_public, published_on, created_at
queries.name: UpdateTitle
comments: Only the fields given change; sqlc.narg() makes each one optional.

queries.text:
INSERT INTO titles (id, name) VALUES (?1, ?2)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name
queries.name: UpsertTitle

queries.text: UPDATE titles SET status = 'published' WHERE id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) RETURNING id, status
queries.name: PublishTitles

queries.text:
SELECT id, name FROM titles
WHERE id NOT IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) -- what about this ? here
  /* or this ?2 one */
ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListTitlesNotIn
comments: Comments inside the statement are skipped by the placeholder scanner, '?' and all.

queries.text:
INSERT INTO views (title_id)
SELECT ?1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM titles WHERE id = ?1)
queries.name: RecordView
comments: The same parameter twice becomes one argument.

queries.text:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT title_id, CAST(max(viewed_at) AS TEXT) AS last_viewed_at FROM views GROUP BY title_id
)
SELECT t.id, t.name, recent.last_viewed_at
FROM titles t JOIN recent ON recent.title_id = t.id
ORDER BY recent.last_viewed_at DESC
queries.name: RecentlyViewedTitles

queries.text:
SELECT t.id, count(v.title_id) AS views, CAST(max(v.viewed_at) AS TEXT) AS last_viewed_at
FROM titles t
LEFT JOIN views v ON v.title_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id
queries.name: TitleViewStats
comments: max() over an outer join is null for titles nobody viewed, and sqlc cannot type it
without the cast; it still reads the cast as NOT NULL.
@nullable last_viewed_at

queries.text:
SELECT t.id, v.viewed_at
FROM titles t LEFT JOIN views v ON v.title_id = t.id
WHERE v.viewed_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY v.viewed_at DESC
queries.name: ViewedTitles
comments: The WHERE rules out the LEFT JOIN's nulls, which sqlc cannot see.
@notnull viewed_at

queries.text: DELETE FROM views
queries.name: DeleteAllViews
